description: This PHP class 'Latest' extends the product model in Opencart to retrieve the latest products based on a limit, using SQL queries with caching.

classes.name: Latest
classes.description: A model class for retrieving the latest products in an Opencart store, utilizing SQL queries with caching mechanism.

methods.name: getLatest
methods.description: Retrieves the latest products up to the specified limit, with caching to optimize repeated queries.
